findings.summary: IdentityPort does not expose the required session-only/cancel-and-retain decisions and requires runtime-scoped cancellation for identity work that must precede or outlive that runtime.
The renderer boundary exposes data types whose direct imports and UI reexports are rejected by the declared guard; the allowed UI path keeps them private.
